children: ) ("Cheche" or the "Company"), China's leading auto insurance technology platform, today announced the results of the Company's extraordinary general meeting (the "Meeting") held at 10 A.M. on November 25, 2026, Beijing time (9 P.M. on November 24, 2026, U.S. Eastern time) at 8/F, Desheng Hopson Fortune Plaza, 13-1 Deshengmenwai Avenue, Xicheng District, Beijing 100088, China. All proposals submitted for shareholder approval at the Meeting were approved. Specifically, the shareholders passed resolutions:

(i) the creation of a new class of ordinary shares of the Company designated as class C ordinary shares, each with a par value of US$0.00035 (the "Class C Ordinary Shares"), with the rights and restrictions set forth in the Company's third amended and restated memorandum and articles of association (the "New M&A"), including 300 votes per Class C Ordinary Share;

(ii) the amendment of the Company's authorized share capital from US$50,000 divided into 142,857,143 shares comprising 114,285,714 class A ordinary shares of a par value of US$0.00035 each and 28,571,429 class B ordinary shares of a par value of US$0.00035 each, to US$50,000 divided into 142,857,143 shares comprising 114,285,714 class A ordinary shares of a par value of US$0.00035 each, 18,571,429 class B ordinary shares of a par value of US$0.00035 each and 10,000,000 Class C Ordinary Shares;

(iii) the reclassification of 10,000,000 authorized but unissued class B ordinary shares of a par value of US$0.00035 each as 10,000,000 Class C Ordinary Shares with the rights attached to them under the New M&A; and
(iv) the authorizations to implement the foregoing matters as set out in the notice of the Meeting; and

(2) to approve, by special resolution, the amendment and restatement of the Company's second amended and restated memorandum and articles of association by replacing them in their entirety with the New M&A, to provide for, among other things, the creation and rights of the Class C Ordinary Shares, including 300 votes per Class C Ordinary Share, and, by ordinary resolution, the authorizations to give effect to these resolutions, including filing the New M&A with the Registrar of Companies in the Cayman Islands.

Established in 2014 and headquartered in Beijing, China, Cheche is a leading auto insurance technology platform with a nationwide network of around 108 branches licensed to distribute insurance policies across 25 provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities in China. Capitalizing on its leading position in auto insurance transaction services, Cheche has evolved into a comprehensive, data-driven technology platform that offers a full suite of services and products for digital insurance transactions and insurance SaaS solutions in China.
